text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi assets frozen in Arab countries reach $1.5 billion.
- Turkey decides to lift embargo on its cross-border trade with Iraq.
- Trade Minister Mohammed Mehdi Saleh meets a Syrian health official.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and IRAQ)
- Commentaries lashing out at the decision of excluding Iraq from the Pan Arab Games which will be held in Lebanon.
- Editorial criticising some Arab countries for taking tough positions against Iraq and the U.N. sanctions.
